text: {"lessons":["I will avoid letting early gains tempt me to sell strong holdings while later buying back at much higher prices; I’ll make exits depend on the investment outlook and a consistent plan.","My large loss in Stock B showed that a falling price is not, by itself, a reason to keep holding or to buy more; I’ll reassess the thesis and limit how much any one position can hurt the portfolio.","Before buying, I’ll define my reason for entering, acceptable risk, and conditions for exiting, then review the whole portfolio rather than reacting to each month’s price moves."]}
